name: XTTSv2 NxD Inference precompile (DLC, BF16)
description: Compile XTTSv2 GPT (Prefill + Decode) inside an AWS Neuron Deep Learning Container — public.ecr.aws/neuron/pytorch-inference-neuronx:2.9.0-neuronx-py312-sdk2.28.0-ubuntu24.04. SDK 2.28 is pinned because newer SDK 2.30 (neuronx-cc 2.25.3371) trips an internal compiler bug ([NCC_IXRO002] Undefined SB Memloc) on this model's scatter-based KV cache. Idempotent: short-circuits on .compile_metadata.json + prefill/ + decode/ presence (FORCE_RECOMPILE=true overrides). NEURON_RT_VISIBLE_CORES pins TP=4 cores (default 0-3). Source (compile_xttsv2_nxd.py + neuron_xttsv2/) is fetched via presigned S3 URL and mounted into the DLC. 16 GB swap is provisioned to keep the tracer alive on the trn2.3xlarge memory budget.

tasks.name: Verify docker + Neuron device + DLC image presence
tasks.description: Confirms docker daemon, /dev/neuron0 and image are ready. The image is pulled separately in 05-pull-image so the precheck does not block on a 10+GB download.
commands: command -v docker >/dev/null || { echo '[NG] docker not installed'; exit 1; }
systemctl is-active docker.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '[NG] docker.service not active'; exit 1; }
test -e /dev/neuron0 || { echo '[NG] /dev/neuron0 missing — not a trn1/trn2 host?'; exit 1; }
command -v curl tar >/dev/null || { echo '[NG] curl/tar required'; exit 1; }

tasks.name: Ensure {{SWAP_SIZE_GB}}GB swap is available
tasks.description: XTTSv2 compile traces ~3GB tensors and OOMs without swap on trn2.3xlarge. We allocate {{SWAP_SIZE_GB}}GB on first run; if {{SWAP_FILE}} already exists the step is a no-op.
commands: if swapon --show=NAME --noheadings 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^{{SWAP_FILE}}$'; then echo '[OK] swap already on'; exit 0; fi

tasks.name: Pull DLC image if missing
tasks.description: docker pull is idempotent and resumes incomplete layers. Image is ~10GB and may take 5-10 min on first pull from public ECR.
commands: if docker image inspect '{{DLC_IMAGE}}' >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[OK] image already present'; exit 0; fi

tasks.name: Skip the heavy compile if artefacts already exist
tasks.description: Bail out early when prefill/ + decode/ + .compile_metadata.json are all present and FORCE_RECOMPILE=false.
commands: if [ '{{FORCE_RECOMPILE}}' = 'true' ]; then echo '[INFO] FORCE_RECOMPILE=true, will recompile'; rm -f {{COMPILED_MODEL_PATH}}/.precompile_skipped; exit 0; fi

if [ -f {{COMPILED_MODEL_PATH}}/.compile_metadata.json ] && [ -d {{COMPILED_MODEL_PATH}}/prefill ] && [ -d {{COMPILED_MODEL_PATH}}/decode ]; then echo '[OK] artefacts already present, skip'; touch {{COMPILED_MODEL_PATH}}/.precompile_skipped; exit 0; fi

tasks.name: Fetch compile_xttsv2_nxd.py + neuron_xttsv2/ tarball
tasks.description: Pull the source tarball produced by deploy-all.sh from its presigned S3 URL and extract under WORK_DIR. The tarball is mounted read-only into the DLC at /src.
commands: if [ -f {{COMPILED_MODEL_PATH}}/.precompile_skipped ] && [ '{{FORCE_RECOMPILE}}' != 'true' ]; then echo '[OK] skipped (cached)'; exit 0; fi
test -n '{{SOURCE_TARBALL_URL}}' || { echo '[NG] SOURCE_TARBALL_URL is empty'; exit 1; }
test -f {{WORK_DIR}}/source/compile_xttsv2_nxd.py || { echo '[NG] compile_xttsv2_nxd.py missing after extract'; exit 1; }
test -d {{WORK_DIR}}/source/neuron_xttsv2 || { echo '[NG] neuron_xttsv2/ missing after extract'; exit 1; }

tasks.name: Download XTTSv2 checkpoint via Coqui TTS if missing
tasks.description: Ensure {{XTTS_MODEL_DIR}}/model.pth + config.json exist. Runs Coqui's ModelManager.download_model inside the DLC so we do not pollute the host venv. Idempotent: skipped when model.pth already exists.
commands: if [ -f {{COMPILED_MODEL_PATH}}/.precompile_skipped ] && [ '{{FORCE_RECOMPILE}}' != 'true' ]; then echo '[OK] skipped (cached)'; exit 0; fi
if [ -f {{XTTS_MODEL_DIR}}/model.pth ] && [ -f {{XTTS_MODEL_DIR}}/config.json ]; then echo '[OK] checkpoint already present'; exit 0; fi

cat > /tmp/xttsv2_dl_ckpt.py <<'PYEOF'
import os, shutil, glob
from TTS.utils.manage import ModelManager
m = ModelManager()
result = m.download_model(os.environ['XTTSV2_MODEL_ID'])
if isinstance(result, (list, tuple)) and len(result) >= 1:
    src = result[0]
else:
    raise SystemExit(f'unexpected download_model return: {result!r}')
dst = os.environ['XTTSV2_DEST_DIR']
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(str(src), '*')):
    shutil.copy(p, os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(p)))
print(f'[OK] checkpoint copied to {dst}')
PYEOF
test -f {{XTTS_MODEL_DIR}}/model.pth || { echo '[NG] model.pth missing after download'; exit 1; }
test -f {{XTTS_MODEL_DIR}}/config.json || { echo '[NG] config.json missing after download'; exit 1; }

tasks.name: Run compile_xttsv2_nxd.py inside the DLC (BF16)
tasks.description: Compile both Prefill + Decode applications inside the SDK 2.28 DLC. On trn2 with the bundled neuronx-cc 2.23 this finishes in ~1-2 minutes per stage. MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=2 reduces glibc fragmentation; --shm-size 8g satisfies torch_xla's shared-memory needs.
commands: if [ -f {{COMPILED_MODEL_PATH}}/.precompile_skipped ] && [ '{{FORCE_RECOMPILE}}' != 'true' ]; then echo '[OK] skipped (cached)'; exit 0; fi

-lc "pip install --quiet 'coqui-tts==0.26.*' 'soundfile>=0.12' 2>&1 | tail -5 && pip install --quiet 'torchaudio==2.9.*' --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu 2>&1 | tail -5 && python compile_xttsv2_nxd.py --model-path {{XTTS_MODEL_DIR}} --output-dir {{COMPILED_MODEL_PATH}} --tp-degree {{TP_DEGREE}} --seq-len {{SEQ_LEN}}"

tasks.name: Verify compiled artefacts
tasks.description: .compile_metadata.json + prefill/ + decode/ must all be present.
